release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (AUTODOME_inteox_7000_Data_sheet_enUS_84333629707.pdf). Clear-bubble IP66 pendant model, open camera platform (OC); "available in specific regions only". Effective pixels 1944x1212 (2.35 MP), 1080p output. Power 51 W typical with heaters (19.2 W heaters off). Operating temperature -40 to 55 C with heater wired (-10 to 55 C without). IK10 applies only to "-IK10" bubble models, not this SKU. Max fps taken from the highest-resolution bitrate table (30 fps).

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
